main_text.p: אשון [?] m. Idem, Prov.20.20. Targum אתונא mutato ש in ת. התאשש [?] Virum praebuit se. Imperat. התאששו [?] Viros praebete vos, Jes.46.8. Vide etiam infrà in אש.

איתן m. Fortis, Robustus, Validus; metaphoricè Asper, Horridus: Et substantivè, Vis, Robur, אל־נחל איתן Ad vallem horridam, sive asperam aut duram, Deut.21.4. באיתן In robore,Gen.49.24. Aff. לאיתנו Ad vim suā,Exod.14.27. Semel absq; ', אתן Forti, scil. dolore, ut supplent Ab.Esra & R.Levi,Job.33.19. Plur. ואיתנים Et validos, Job.12.19. Et absq; ', והאתנים Et robusta, Mich.6.2. Fuit & Ethanim mensis septimi, id est, Septembris nomen: ut, In mense Ethanim, is est mensis septimus, 1.Reg.8.2. Ante exitū ex Aegypto, hic mensis anni Civilis erat primus, post exitū factus septimus anni Ecclesiastici, ratione festorū, Exod.12.2. Inde Paraphrastes Chaldeus hoc loco transfert, בירחא דעתיקיא קרו ליה ירחא קדמאה וכען הוא ירחא שביעאה [?] In mense, quē (prisci) vocarunt mensem primum, nūc est mensis septimus. Postea anni civilis initium rediit in principium mensis Septembris, quem usque hodie vocant תשרי Tisri.

איתי Chald. Est, Sunt, Hebraicè יש, & adjunctis Affixis, personae distinguuntur. In Daniele semper dicitur איתי: ut, איתי גבר Est vir, Dan.5.11. איתי גברין Sunt viri, Dan.3.12. Affixa, לא איתוהי Non est ipsa, Dan.2.11. האיתך Nunquid es tu, v. 26. איתיכון Estis vos,Dan.3.14. איתנא Sumus nos, Dan.3.18. In Targum dicitur איתי.
אך Tantùm; Tantummodò, Duntaxat, Verumtamen, Sed, Profectò, Certè, Utiq;, Omninò, Sanè. In media sententia fere Exclusiva est, Genes.18.32. Exod.10.16. אך הרק An tantùm duntaxat, Tantummodò, Num.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek letters are approximate in places; the scan is small and smudged, so doubtful Hebrew words carry [?]. The top-centre running head is read as אי [?]. The headwords אית and אך are set in larger type and are treated as entry lines within the text. The word "Num." at the right of the last line is printed as a continuation of that entry.
